evidence.description: Last Call Improv takes over Thursday nights at 9:30 PM for a wild, dynamic mix of styles and forms. Following right after the regular Thursday show, this late-night staple features a rotating lineup of performance troupes hand-picked from open submissions. The evening is anchored by Wanted Live , a featured headliner performing a TJ and Dave-style long-form improv set, where grounded, authentic human behavior drives the comedy. Whether you are looking for experimental forms or high-energy laughs, Last Call Improv offers an unpredictable, one-of-a-kind experience every single week.

events.title: Meghan Wysocki, carillon
events.summary: Enjoy a 30-minute carillon recital by Meghan Wysocki. Visitors can ascend the tower to view the bells and the carillonist at work. This event offers a unique musical experience with impressive bell acoustics.

evidence.description:
Meghan Wysocki performs on the Ann & Robert H. Lurie Carillon, an instrument of 60 bells with the lowest bell (bourdon) weighing 6 tons.

Thirty-minute recitals are performed on the Lurie Carillon every weekday that classes are in session. During these recitals, visitors may take the elevator to level 2 to view the largest bells, or to level 3 to see the carillonist performing. (Visitors subject to acrophobia are recommended to visit level 2 only.) An optional spiral stairway between levels 2 and 3 allows for up-close views of some of the largest bells.

events.title: Symphony Band
events.summary: The University of Michigan Symphony Band presents an All-American program featuring diverse works that reflect the nation's history and future. This concert includes pieces by Copland, Ives, and a U-M commission, celebrating American voices.

evidence.description: In recognition of the end of our 250th year as a free nation, the University of Michigan Symphony Band presents an All-American program from the diverse voices that permeate our country. From the overtly patriotic to the fiercely democratic, the collection of works on this program tell the story of a resilient and undaunted nation that embraces both a turbulent past and a hopeful future.
